mapper.select: SELECT files_details.id, files_details.`name`, files_details.cover, files_details.over_status, files_details.`status`, files_details.love, files_details.files_id, files.is_folder, files_details.last_read_time, files_details.`profile`, files_details.bgm_id, files_details.date, files_details.original_name, parent_id, file_path FROM files_details INNER JOIN files ON files_details.files_id = files.id AND files.deleted = 1 WHERE files_details.deleted = 1 AND files_details.files_id = #{id}

SELECT files_details.id, files_details.over_status, files_details.`status`, files_details.love, `name`, files_details.cover, files_details.files_id, files.is_folder, parent_id, file_path FROM files_details INNER JOIN files ON files_details.files_id = files.id AND files.deleted = 1 WHERE files_details.deleted = 1 AND files_details.`status` in (2,3) ORDER BY `last_read_time` DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT files_details.status FROM files INNER JOIN files_details ON files.id = files_details.files_id AND files_details.deleted = 1 WHERE files.deleted = 1 AND parent_id = #{id}

SELECT files_details.over_status, files_details.`status`, files_details.love, files.is_folder FROM files_details INNER JOIN files ON files_details.files_id = files.id AND files.deleted = 1 WHERE files_details.deleted = 1
